links.outcome: Safety adherence on penicillin anaphylaxis trap vignette across five LLMs
links.effect: Kimi K2 Thinking and ChatGPT-5.2 scored 3.50/3.50 with perfect safety adherence; DeepSeek V3.2 3.46; Gemini 3 Pro and Claude 4.5 Opus incurred safety penalties for suggesting carbapenems in severe IgE-mediated anaphylaxis.
links.quote: Conversely, Gemini 3 Pro and Claude 4.5 Opus incurred significant safety penalties for suggesting carbapenems in a patient with severe IgE-mediated anaphylaxis, a violation of the study’s strict safety rubric, despite otherwise high clinical competence.

links.outcome: Diagnostic accuracy and contraindication handling in clinical vignettes
links.effect: Kimi K2 Thinking and ChatGPT-5.2 showed 100% diagnostic accuracy and perfect safety adherence; Gemini 3 Pro and Claude 4.5 Opus recommended carbapenems in severe penicillin anaphylaxis, missing the contraindication.
links.quote: Kimi K2 Thinking and ChatGPT-5.2 achieved the highest aggregate scores (3.50/3.50), demonstrating 100% diagnostic accuracy and perfect safety adherence.

screen.reason: Evaluates and benchmarks multiple contemporary reasoning LLMs on synthetic clinical vignettes and safety contraindications, but does not test a specific deployment practice or safeguard.
